evals.prompt: Port dashboard/redis/redis.json to Go dashboardv2 as UID redis in the Databases folder. Do not edit the legacy JSON.
evals.expected_output: internal/queries/prometheus/redis/*.go with PromQL constants, internal/dashboards/redis/redis.go exporting a builder, test/dashboards/redis_test.go, a registry entry, regenerated generated/ and deploy/ output, make validate green
expectations: dashboard/redis/redis.json is unchanged
queries live in internal/queries/prometheus/<domain>/ and are imported by the dashboard, not inlined
the board uses panels.* helpers (SeriesExpr, Stat, RowsLayout, Row, GridItem) rather than raw dashboardv2 layout calls
the registry entry sets both a standards.Domain* and a standards.Folder* constant
a contract test asserts title, panel count, variable count, manifest name and key metric fragments
generated/dashboards/redis/redis.spec.json and deploy/dashboards/grafanamanifest-redis.yaml exist after make generate, and the CR template carries the dashboard.grafana.app/v2 spec inline
the agent reports the make validate result

evals.prompt: Add a Network section to the kubernetes cluster overview dashboard using queries from internal/queries/prometheus/kubernetes/.
evals.expected_output: cluster_overview.go gains a panels.Row("Network", ...) with new panels backed by shared query constants; kubernetes_cluster_overview_test.go panel count updated; no other dashboard changed
expectations: new PromQL is added as constants in internal/queries/prometheus/kubernetes/cluster.go, not as string literals in the dashboard
the panel-count assertion in the test is updated to the new value
no file outside internal/queries/prometheus/kubernetes, internal/dashboards/kubernetes, test/dashboards, generated, deploy is modified
make validate passes

evals.prompt: Add a warning alert when Temporal activity failures exceed 5% of executions for 10 minutes, linked to the temporal-worker dashboard.
evals.expected_output: an alerts.Rule in internal/alerts/observability.go with Group observability, registered in internal/registry/alerts.go, generating grafanaalertrulegroup-observability.yaml
expectations: the rule reuses or adds a constant under internal/queries/prometheus/observability/
UID follows <domain>_<resource>_<condition>
labels severity, domain, component and annotations summary, description, dashboard_uid=temporal-worker are set via standards.* keys
TestAlertRegistry passes without modification
a new GrafanaAlertRuleGroup manifest appears in deploy/ and deploy/kustomization.yaml lists it

evals.prompt: Port dashboard/postgresql/pgbouncer.json and dashboard/redis/redis-exporter.json in parallel using subagents, then register both and validate.
evals.expected_output: two worker slices following references/multi-agent.md, one orchestrator edit to the registry, one make generate, one make validate
expectations: the orchestrator reads references/multi-agent.md and briefs each worker with the slice template
each worker touches only its own query, dashboard and test files
workers do not edit internal/registry, internal/standards, internal/panels, generated or deploy
internal/registry/dashboards.go is edited once by the orchestrator with both entries
make generate and make validate are run once each, by the orchestrator, after registration
the final report lists both UIDs, panel counts and the make validate result
